EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Congratulations you are covered in Mexico!
Your policy is attached to this email. We recommend you print a copy and keep it in the glove box. Having the paperwork in your glove box allows for the retrieval of important information in case you are unable to provide it electronically. You will also need to provide a paper copy to the dockmaster.
Be sure to check out our Border Crossing page to make sure you have everything else you need.
Thank you for choosing MexInsurance®!
Charles Lundy
